ablation.intro: Switch a rule off, rerun, read the NPV drop. No drop means the rule is a candidate for removal.
ablation.rule.R0.name: Profitability threshold
ablation.rule.R0.statement: Keep a well running while it pays for its own upkeep.
ablation.rule.R1.name: Injection split by marginal value
ablation.rule.R1.statement: Water goes to the wells where it turns into oil, not into water.
ablation.rule.R2.name: Withdrawal level
ablation.rule.R2.statement: Push the clean wells, choke the watered ones.
ablation.rule.R3.name: Hysteresis
ablation.rule.R3.statement: Shut after N months of loss, reopen only with a margin.
ablation.rule.R4.name: ESP threshold
ablation.rule.R4.statement: Do not cross a pump size boundary unless the extra rate pays for the pump.
ablation.rule.R5.name: Voidage replacement
ablation.rule.R5.statement: Keep the pattern voidage replacement inside its corridor.
ablation.rule.R6.name: Conversion to injection
ablation.rule.R6.statement: Convert a well when it is worth more as an injector than as a producer.
ablation.rule.R7.name: Cyclic operation
ablation.rule.R7.statement: Periodically shut the heavily watered wells to mobilise the trapped oil.
ablation.summary.gap: The rest is unexplained by rules — never measured: {count}.
ablation.summary.gapNone: Every rule measured: the total is fully broken down.
